title: Link a device
intro: Move your account to a new device by scanning a code. Your Security Code stays the same.
showCode: Show a link code on this device
qrText: Or copy this code to the device that is already signed in:
safetyCode: Check that this number matches the other device: {code}
enterCode: On the signed-in device, paste the link code from the new device:
errorInvalid: That link code is not valid.
errorNoKey: This device cannot link others yet.
confirmPrompt: Only continue if this number is identical on both devices.
